tasks.title: Test purging and temporal split boundaries

tasks.title: Run a small eligible development-window comparison

tasks.title: Review cross-family redundancy and missing coverage

tasks.title: Prepare a temporally out-of-sample training dataset

tasks.title: Specify the first learned-Core experiment and acceptance rule

tasks.title: Validate status freshness and interrupted-run recovery
